newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RBNZ's Brash says NZ dollar near top of cycle.
newsitem.headline: RBNZ's Brash says NZ dollar near top of cycle.

text.p: Reserve Bank of New Zealand Governor Don Brash said on Thursday the New Zealand dollar was near the top of its cycle.

"I have often suggested the exchange rate goes through cycles, the real exchange rate, particularly, goes through cycles. At the moment it's in the top of one of those cycles," Brash told reporters after addressing a summit of exporters in Wellington.
Brash said there was nothing new in what he was saying, and he was not attempting to send a signal to the markets, which was why his speech to the conference was off the record.
